title.en: Plan A — Kidney omics anomaly detection
title.zh: Plan A:肾脏组学异常检测

lead.en: Learn normal kidney from healthy data, then flag what it cannot explain; one modality is evidence on another.
lead.zh: 从健康数据学习正常肾脏，再标出它解释不了的细胞和区域；用一个模态作为另一个模态的证据。

title.zh: Plan B:可信的生物医学 agent

lead.en: Trace every agent claim back through code and data; calibrate the verifier against experts.
lead.zh: 把 agent 的每条结论追溯到代码和数据；用专家标注校准核查器。

title.zh: 桥：两个 plan 共用的论文

lead.en: Papers that Plan A and Plan B both depend on.
lead.zh: Plan A 和 Plan B 都要用到的论文。

lead.zh: Sikander 2026 年 7–9 月推荐的全部内容，按 detect → model → revert 排列。
